entries.title: Forsakenween 2026 balance changes
items: Updated 1x1x1x1's walk and sprint speed, Mass Infection, Entanglement, Unstable Eye and Rejuvenate the Rotten.
Updated Elliot's Pizza Throw and Rush Hour, and added the two new Rush Hour rewards.
Updated Noob's Bloxy Cola, Slateskin Potion and Ghostburger.
Updated Two Time's Crouch and the Crouch backstab stun.
Exhausted now lowers stamina by 5% per level instead of 10%.
